description: "Draw forth your tome and invoke the leviathanum of the Abyssal Sea to conjure a vortex of eldritch power. Entering this vortex grants you and your allies Minor Courage, Minor Fortitude, Minor Intellect, and Minor Endurance, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff215|r and your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.\n\nThe vortex also heals you and your allies for |cffffff14597|r Health over |cffffff20|r seconds."
